
[yellow bold]-- DEPRECATION -- main.volt:1[/yellow bold]

Move `chip esp32` to volt.toml: chip = "esp32"

 [dim]1 |[/dim] chip esp32
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]     ^^^^^[/yellow]

[cyan]Hint: The chip declaration will move to volt.toml in a future version.[/cyan]


[yellow bold]-- HARDWARE WARNING -- main.volt:2[/yellow bold]

Strapping pin: GPIO 2 must be LOW during boot for flash programming.

 [dim]1 |[/dim] chip esp32
 [dim]2 |[/dim] hardware { pin led: Output = 2 }
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]               ^^^[/yellow]


[yellow bold]-- UNREACHABLE -- main.volt:6[/yellow bold]

Code after `every`/`on` block in task `worker` will never execute.

 [dim]5 |[/dim]     every 500ms { led.toggle() }
 [dim]6 |[/dim]     every 1s { log("tick", "one") }
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]          ^^[/yellow]

[cyan]Hint: Move this code before the `every` block, or into a separate task.[/cyan]
